'''Bakur RepulsorCorp HQ''' was located in the [[Bakur Ring|outermost district]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. The structure shared its name with the company [[Bakur RepulsorCorp]].<ref name="GatORW" />
